seats.notes: …aggro: cheap white creatures, removal (Brimstone Volley, Smite x2, Ghostly Possession), and fliers (Chapel Geist, Voiceless Spirit, Spectral Rider) with red drops and Scourge. Cut Cobbled Wings, Fortress Crab and the blue and black cards; 9 Plains and 8 Mountains for 23 spells and 17 lands.

Blue-black tempo-control: creatures, removal (Victim of Night, Dead Weight, Claustrophobia) and card draw. Cut the 8-drop Army, the Curses, the auras and the weak black sorceries to keep the curve low.

…tempo: fliers (Stitched Drake, Moon Heron, Battleground Geist, Invisible Stalker) plus removal (Sensory Deprivation, Sever the Bloodline, Silent Departure, Blazing Torch) and card selection. Cut white and green cards, Dream Twist, Memory's Journey and Cellar Door as too weak for the curve.

…deepest colour, so I'm building white-blue with 23 spells: removal (Rebuke, Ghostly Possession, Lost in the Mist), fliers (Voiceless Spirit, Moon Heron), and the colourless Juggernaut and Geistcatcher's Rig. I cut green, the second Wooden Stake, Purify the Grave, and the weaker blue and red cards.

W/R aggro: cheap white creatures, Furor of the Bitten, two Harvest Pyre and fliers (Abbey Griffin, Midnight Haunting) with Rally the Peasants. Left out the off-colour cards, Rage Thrower and Moorland Haunt; 9 Plains and 8 Mountains match the white-heavy pips.

Green-black midrange: Garruk and removal (Dead Weight, Prey Upon, Tribute to Hunger, Morkrut Banshee) plus a solid green creature base and Spider Spawning for late game. Cut Brain Weevil, Hamlet Captain, and Orchard Spirit to fit 23 spells with 17 lands.

Black-red vampires with removal: Balefire Dragon as the bomb, three Crossway Vampires, Devil's Play, Geistflame, Corpse Lunge and Morkrut Banshee, backed by 2- and 3-drop creatures. Cut Bump in the Night and Traitorous Blood to fit 23 spells with 17 lands.

…midrange: green creatures and fight/burn removal (Prey Upon, Brimstone Volley, Geistflame, Into the Maw of Hell) with a curve of 2-3 drops. Cut Bloodcrazed Neonate and the weaker enchantments, sweepers, and card-draw spells for Bramblecrush as a noncreature answer; 10 Forest and 7 Mountain.
